accounting_treatment: coupon/accrual + possible price/sale effects inside aggregate securities result
direct_flow_identity: Issuer-flow exists for contractual accrual; valuation/sale component is not a contemporaneous BCRA payment
evidence: BCRA reports broader liquidity shifted toward monetary-regulation instruments in 2014; LEBAC/NOBAC were material and increased. Annual ROA abnormality was securities-led.
caveat: 0–1.4 pp is a marginal bucket envelope, not an estimate and not jointly additive with Treasury/market envelopes.

direct_flow_identity: Only coupon/accrual on identified Treasury instruments is a direct Treasury→bank flow
evidence: Aggregate securities result pools issuers/treatments; V52 did not recover an instrument-level profit split.
caveat: Secondary-market appreciation cannot be labeled Treasury payment.

accounting_treatment: price appreciation, sale gains, FX-linked security valuation where applicable
direct_flow_identity: No bilateral payer required for mark-to-market appreciation
evidence: The result category is not issuer-pure and 2014 reports mention changes in title-value results; exact treatment split is absent.
caveat: Upper bound is component capacity only.

direct_flow_identity: Direct issuer-flow only for contractual accrual; market valuation separate
evidence: BCRA documents LEBAC/LELIQ in liquid assets and a June shift away from them after reserve-requirement changes.
caveat: No exact H1 securities abnormal sub-gap was frozen.

direct_flow_identity: Treasury direct only for identified contractual accrual
evidence: From June, reserve requirements could be integrated with Treasury Bonos 2020; BCRA records an asset-composition shift from LEBAC/LELIQ toward public-sector assets.
caveat: Policy-induced holdings do not identify H1 abnormal income share.

accounting_treatment: LELIQ/other BCRA instrument accrual and/or valuation inside titles bucket
direct_flow_identity: Issuer-flow possible, but not all titles result is issuer cashflow
evidence: Q4 includes Oct-Nov when LELIQ remained active; from 19 Dec BCRA stopped LELIQ auctions and shifted to passes.
caveat: 0–7.3 pp is not an estimate. The upper envelope overlaps Treasury/market envelopes.

direct_flow_identity: Direct Treasury/public flow only for identified contractual accrual
evidence: At Sep-23 nonfinancial public-sector exposure was 17.7% of assets: 8.6% CER instruments, 5.6% dual bonds, 2.1% peso non-CER securities and 1.4% FX instruments. This is exposure evidence, not profit allocation.
caveat: Stock/exposure shares cannot mechanically allocate the +7.3 pp result.

evidence: V52 froze part of the securities channel as market valuation; aggregate table does not isolate price vs contractual accrual.
caveat: Do not call the whole titles gap a Treasury/BCRA payment.
